<quoted>
---------------------- Forwarded by Margaret Thomas on 1/10/2025 09:26 AM ---------------------------


"Renault, Susan" <susan.renault@velzengroup.edu> on 12/24/2024 10:59:38 AM
To: "aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr'" <aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr>
cc: "margaret.thomas@lumieresante.fr '" <margaret.thomas@lumieresante.fr> 
Subject: RE: Lyon Clinical Trials


Dear Aimé / Margaret,

Thanks for coming to Marseille to present an overview of the projects. We enjoyed meeting you and your colleagues and look forward to working with Lumière Santé. I would also like to pass on my team's appreciation for the dinner as well.

We wanted to give you an update on our project and get some feedback and additional information prior to our upcoming visit to Lyon on January 17th. Our project is going to be geared to the 3rd option you mentioned. We plan on addressing some part of Clinique Belle Vue business. We are considering two options regarding this topic and would like to pursue either (i)how patients are acquired and recommending new processes and ways to serve private patients, OR (ii) studying the supply chain for medical supplies and coming up with recommendations for areas for further investments.

However, we would like to get some more information on the Clinical Operations before truly scoping the project. We are also very open to suggestions, especially if you had a much broader or different scope in mind; so please let us know.

We have not yet reviewed the introductory information received last week, but here are the questions we have specific to Clinique Belle Vue unit:

Can we look at its overall business plan or a more detailed summary than is in the annual report? What is the pricing philosophy/overall structure? Who are the patients and how are they acquired? What would the patients be doing if they did not work with Lumière Santé? What are the international expansion plans and capabilities? Is there any important regulatory summary information we can have?

If this information is not already covered in the review material you sent, will you be able recommend other sources where we may find such information?

After we have reviewed the material sent to us recently, we may want to schedule a phone call with you and/or one of your colleagues directly involved in Clinique Belle Vue business. I would like to call you in the new year to discuss this further. In the meantime, please feel free to call me at +33 4 59 27 70 77 if you need any information.

Regards,
Clinical Operations Team
Ram
Dennis
Jason
Omar
Steve
Clay
</quoted>
